name: kepler-shell
description: Kepler — Electron host для Kosmos ecosystem (global launcher + extension host)
author: Kazui

scripts.build:extensions: node -e "import('./vite.extensions.config.mjs').then(async (m)=>{const {execSync}=await import('node:child_process');for(const id of m.vueExtensions){console.log('[build:extensions]',id);execSync('vite build --configLoader native --config vite.extensions.config.mjs --mode '+id,{stdio:'inherit'});}if(m.vueExtensions.length===0)console.log('[build:extensions] no Vue extensions to build (only static PoCs present) — skipping');})"
scripts.dev: bun run build:backend:dev && bun run build:extensions && vite --configLoader native
scripts.build:js: tsc && vite build --configLoader native && bun run build:extensions
scripts.build: bun run build:backend && bun run build:js && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.test:e2e: bun run build:js && playwright test --config playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:headed: bun run build:js && playwright test --config playwright.config.ts --headed
